definition_zh: 宣誓书；书面宣誓陈述；宣誓证词
definition_en: a written statement of facts sworn to be true before a person with authority to administer an oath
core_image: 一张写满事实的纸，末尾按着印章，旁边是一只举起的右手
scene: 听证会开始前，证人一早赶到法院。Before the hearing, the witness signed an affidavit that described what she had seen.
sceneCN: 这里 affidavit 是「宣誓书」（第 1 个义项：经宣誓确认属实的书面陈述）；句意：听证会开始前，证人签署了一份宣誓书，描述了她看到的情况。

derivatives.zh: 反宣誓书；用于反驳另一份宣誓书的陈述

senses.title: A written statement confirmed by oath
senses.definition: a written statement of facts that the maker swears is true
senses.definitionCN: 陈述事实并由作出者宣誓属实的书面文件
senses.example: The witness signed an affidavit before the hearing.
senses.exampleCN: 证人在听证会前签署了一份宣誓书。
senses.why: The Latin word affidavit means he has sworn, so the document is named after the act of swearing.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁语 affidavit 意为「他已宣誓」，文件因宣誓这一行为得名。

senses.title: Written testimony used as evidence
senses.definition: sworn written testimony that a court may admit as evidence
senses.definitionCN: 法院可以作为证据采纳的宣誓书面证词
senses.example: The judge admitted the affidavit as evidence.
senses.exampleCN: 法官将这份宣誓书采纳为证据。
senses.why: Once the sworn paper is accepted in court, it works as testimony in written form.
senses.whyCN: 宣誓文书一旦被法院接受，就成为以书面形式呈现的证词。

senses.title: A formal declaration for official records
senses.definition: a sworn declaration used for administrative, financial, or official purposes
senses.definitionCN: 用于行政、财务或官方事务的宣誓声明
senses.example: The bank required an affidavit to release the frozen account.
senses.exampleCN: 银行要求提供一份宣誓声明才解冻账户。
senses.why: Official bodies rely on sworn declarations to fix facts, so the court document spreads to other records.
senses.whyCN: 官方机构靠宣誓声明来确定事实，于是这种法庭文书扩展到其他记录事务。

senses.title: Proof of service in legal procedure
senses.definition: a sworn document that records when and how a legal paper was delivered
senses.definitionCN: 记录法律文书何时、如何送达的宣誓文件
senses.example: The affidavit of service shows that the summons reached the defendant.
senses.exampleCN: 送达宣誓书表明传票已送达被告。
senses.why: Procedure needs proof of each step, so a sworn record of delivery becomes a named type.
senses.whyCN: 程序需要证明每一步，于是记录送达情况的宣誓文书成为一种专名义项。

intro.en: Affidavit is a Medieval Latin verb form, literally he has sworn, from affidare, to pledge faith, built on ad- and fidare.
intro.cn: affidavit 是中世纪拉丁语的动词形式，字面意为「他已宣誓」，来自 affidare（宣誓保证），由 ad- 与 fidare 构成。

items.en: Fidare means to trust, and it comes from fides, faith.
items.cn: fidare 意为信任，来自 fides（信念、信任）。

items.en: Affidare joins ad-, to, with fidare, and means to pledge faith or swear.
items.cn: affidare 由表示「向」的 ad- 与 fidare 组合，意为宣誓保证。

items.en: Affidavit is the third person singular perfect: he or she has sworn.
items.cn: affidavit 是第三人称单数完成式，意为「他或她已宣誓」。

items.en: English borrows affidavit in the 1590s as the name of a sworn written statement.
items.cn: 英语在十六世纪九十年代借入 affidavit，用来指经宣誓的书面陈述。

items.en: Courts now use affidavits as written evidence in many procedures.
items.cn: 现代法院在许多程序中使用宣誓书作为书面证据。

note.en: Affidavit belongs to the oath and trust family of affidare and fides, and stands near words for written testimony.
note.cn: affidavit 属于 affidare、fides 的「宣誓与信任」词族，并与表示书面证词的词相邻。

entries.definition: a person who makes an affidavit
to promise by faith, especially in marriage
entries.definitionCN: 使信任；订婚（与 affidavit 同出拉丁语 affidare）

entries.definition: an affidavit made to oppose another affidavit
entries.definitionCN: 反宣誓书；用于反驳另一份宣誓书的宣誓陈述
庭外宣誓证词；证言笔录

entries.definition: a formal statement, sometimes not sworn

normalIntro.en: Affidavit is literally a Latin verb saying he has sworn: the paper carries the oath inside its name.
normalIntro.cn: affidavit 字面上是一个拉丁语动词，意为「他已宣誓」：文件的名字里就带着誓言。

normal.en: Affidavit comes from affidare, to pledge faith, and fides, faith.
normal.cn: affidavit 来自 affidare（宣誓保证）与 fides（信念、信任）。

normal.en: The Latin ending -vit marks a completed act: the swearing has already happened.
normal.cn: -vit 这一拉丁词尾表示动作已经完成：宣誓已经做过。

normal.en: An affiant is the person who signs the affidavit.
normal.cn: affiant 就是签署宣誓书的人。

normal.en: A sworn affidavit is the common collocation because the oath is essential.
normal.cn: 「sworn affidavit」是常见搭配，因为宣誓是这份文件的关键。

normal.en: Compare deposition: a deposition is oral testimony recorded in writing, while an affidavit is sworn in writing from the start.
normal.cn: 对比 deposition：deposition 是口头证词被记录下来，affidavit 从一开始就是书面的宣誓陈述。

abstract.en: Picture a raised right hand above a signed page.
abstract.cn: 想象一只右手举在已签名的纸页上方。

abstract.en: Picture a judge reading the sworn page as evidence.
abstract.cn: 想象法官把这份宣誓纸页当作证据阅读。

abstract.en: Picture a bank clerk stamping the same sworn page for an official file.
abstract.cn: 想象银行职员为同一份宣誓纸页盖章，放进官方档案。

examples.en: The witness signed an affidavit at the police station.
examples.cn: 证人在警察局签署了一份宣誓书。

examples.en: The court refused to accept an affidavit that had not been sworn.
examples.cn: 法院拒绝接受没有经过宣誓的宣誓书。

examples.en: Affidavits must be filed before the first hearing.
examples.cn: 宣誓书必须在首次听证会之前提交。

dict_mnemonic.text: 谐音「阿菲达维特」——「阿」字开头的一页纸，要宣誓才作数；只是读音联想，与词源无关。

root: 中世纪拉丁语 affidare（宣誓保证）= ad-（向）+ fidare（信任），其第三人称单数完成式 affidavit（他已宣誓）→ 英语 affidavit（宣誓书），核心义「以誓言担保的书面陈述」。

sensesIntro.en: Affidavit first names a sworn statement, then the written testimony it supplies, then an official declaration, and finally a sworn record of service.
sensesIntro.cn: affidavit 先指经宣誓的书面陈述，再指它提供的书面证词，随后指官方宣誓声明，最后指记录送达的宣誓文书。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a signed page under a raised hand and a seal.
core.cn: 核心意象：一只举起的手和一枚印章压在一页签名文书上。

branches.en: The sworn written statement is the core sense.
branches.cn: 经宣誓的书面陈述是核心义项。

branches.en: The same paper serves as written testimony in court.
branches.cn: 同一份文书在法庭上充当书面证词。

branches.en: Official bodies use the sworn form for their own records.
branches.cn: 官方机构把这种宣誓形式用于自己的记录事务。

branches.en: A sworn record of delivery is a specialised type of the same form.
branches.cn: 送达宣誓书是同一形式的专门类型。

branches.en: A single affidavit can be both a sworn statement and evidence.
branches.cn: 同一份宣誓书既可以是一份宣誓陈述，也可以是证据。

intro.en: Affidavit comes from the Latin faith family: fides, fidare, affidare, and its perfect form affidavit, with English affiant and counter-affidavit built on it.
intro.cn: affidavit 来自拉丁语「信念」词族：fides、fidare、affidare 及其完成式 affidavit；英语在此基础上构成 affiant 与 counter-affidavit。

latinIntro.en: Latin affidare means to pledge faith or swear, and affidavit is its third person singular perfect, he has sworn.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 affidare 意为宣誓保证，affidavit 是其第三人称单数完成式，意为「他已宣誓」。

items.example: The prefix ad- points the oath toward a person or authority.
items.exampleCN: 前缀 ad- 把誓言指向某个人或某个权威。

items.example: Fides is the faith behind the oath.
items.exampleCN: fides 是誓言背后的信念。
fidare 提供「信任」这一核心。

items.example: Affidare joins ad- and fidare into a verb of swearing.
items.exampleCN: affidare 把 ad- 与 fidare 组合成表示宣誓的动词。

items.example: Affidavit began as a Latin verb form.
items.exampleCN: affidavit 最初是一个拉丁语动词形式。

items.meaningCN: 第三人称单数完成式词尾
items.example: The ending -vit marks a completed act.
items.exampleCN: 词尾 -vit 标记一个已完成的动作。
affidavit 后来成为英语名词。

items.meaning: a person who makes an affidavit
items.example: Affiant names the maker of the statement.
items.exampleCN: affiant 指作出这份陈述的人。

items.example: Counter-affidavit adds a prefix of opposition.
items.exampleCN: counter-affidavit 加上了一个表示对抗的前缀。

definition_zh: 监护权；照管；拘留；羁押；保管
definition_en: the legal right or protective care of a person or thing, or the state of being held by the police
core_image: 一双手围成护栏，把需要看护的人护在中间
scene: 离婚诉讼结束后，法官把两个孩子叫到身边。After the divorce, the court granted the mother custody of the two children.
sceneCN: 这里 custody 是「监护权」（第 1 个义项：照顾子女的法定权利与责任）；句意：离婚后，法院把两个孩子的监护权判给了母亲。

senses.title: Legal guardianship of a child
senses.definition: the legal right and responsibility to care for a child
senses.definitionCN: 照顾子女的法定权利与责任
senses.example: The court awarded the mother custody of both children.
senses.exampleCN: 法院把两个孩子的监护权判给了母亲。
senses.why: The Latin custos is a guardian, so the first sense is the right held by the person who guards a child.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁语 custos 意为「看守者」，所以第一个义项是照看孩子的人所拥有的权利。

senses.title: Protective keeping of a person or thing
senses.definition: the state of being watched over and kept safe
senses.definitionCN: 受到看护并被妥善保管的状态
senses.example: The museum holds the paintings in custody for the nation.
senses.exampleCN: 博物馆为国家保管这些画作。
senses.why: A guardian also guards objects, so custody extends from children to valuable things.
senses.whyCN: 看守者不只照看孩子，也看守物品，所以 custody 从监护延伸到对贵重之物的保管。

senses.title: Police detention
senses.definition: the state of being held by the police before a charge is decided
senses.definitionCN: 在指控确定之前被警方关押的状态
senses.example: The suspect was taken into custody at the airport.
senses.why: The state can guard a person against leaving, and that guarded hold is police custody.
senses.whyCN: 国家可以看住一个人使其不能离开，这种被看守的关押就是警方拘留。

senses.title: Imprisonment after conviction
senses.definition: the state of being kept in prison as a punishment
senses.definitionCN: 作为惩罚被关在监狱中的状态
senses.example: He spent three years in custody for the offence.
senses.exampleCN: 他因该罪行被监禁三年。
senses.why: A guarded hold continues after sentence, so custody also names imprisonment.
senses.whyCN: 宣判之后「看住」仍在继续，因此 custody 也指监禁服刑。

senses.title: Legal keeping of records or evidence
senses.definition: the legal responsibility for keeping documents, records, or evidence safe
senses.definitionCN: 对文件、记录或证据负有的保管责任
senses.example: The clerk has custody of the court records.
senses.exampleCN: 书记员负责保管法庭记录。
senses.why: Records must be kept under watch, so the guarding image gives a sense of official keeping.
senses.whyCN: 记录必须在看管下保存，于是「看守」的意象又生出官方保管这一义项。

intro.en: Custody comes from Latin custodia, guarding or watch, from custos, a guardian or watchman.
intro.cn: custody 来自拉丁语 custodia（看守、守护），源于 custos（看守者、监护人）。

items.en: Custos means a guardian, keeper, or watchman.
items.cn: custos 意为看守者、保管人或监护人。

items.en: Custodia means guarding, watch, or custody.
items.cn: custodia 意为看守、守护或监禁。

items.en: Custodie is generally thought to carry the legal sense of keeping into English law.
items.cn: 一般认为，盎格鲁-法语 custodie 把「保管」的法律含义带入英国法。

items.en: Custody names watchful care and safe keeping.
items.cn: 中古英语 custody 指警觉的照看与妥善保管。

items.en: Modern English extends custody to child guardianship and police detention.
items.cn: 现代英语把 custody 扩展到子女监护与警方拘留。

note.en: Custody belongs to the guarding family of custos and custodia, and stands near words for guardianship and detention.
note.cn: custody 属于 custos、custodia 的「看守」词族，并与监护、拘留类词相邻。

entries.definition: a person who takes care of a place or collection
the office or duty of a custodian
the legal role of a guardian
the state of being kept in official confinement
the act of watching over a person or activity

normalIntro.en: Custody is built on custos, a guard: the word pictures a watch kept over someone or something.
normalIntro.cn: custody 建立在 custos（看守者）之上：这个词描绘的是对人或物持续不断的看护。

normal.en: Custos is the guardian, and custodia is the guarding; custody keeps both ideas.
normal.cn: custos 是看守者，custodia 是看守行为；custody 同时保留这两层意思。

normal.en: A custodian keeps a building or a collection safe.
normal.cn: custodian 负责保管建筑或藏品。

normal.en: Custodial care describes the care given to a child or patient.
normal.cn: 「custodial care」指对孩子或病人的照护。

normal.en: In custody means held by the police, a phrase heard in news reports.
normal.cn: 「in custody」表示被警方拘留，是新闻报道中的常见说法。

normal.en: Child custody and police custody show the two poles of the word: care and control.
normal.cn: 「child custody」与「police custody」展示了这个词的两极：照护与控制。

abstract.en: Picture two hands forming a low fence around a child.
abstract.cn: 想象两只手围成矮矮的护栏，护住一个孩子。

abstract.en: Picture a museum keeper holding a fragile painting.
abstract.cn: 想象博物馆管理员捧着一幅易损的画。

abstract.en: Picture a guard standing beside a closed door.
abstract.cn: 想象一名看守站在关着的门旁。

examples.en: The court gave the father custody of the two boys.
examples.cn: 法院把两个男孩的监护权判给了父亲。

examples.en: The suspect remained in police custody for two days.
examples.cn: 嫌疑人被警方拘留了两天。

examples.en: She was awarded custody after a long dispute.
examples.cn: 经过漫长的争执，她获得了监护权。

dict_mnemonic.text: 谐音「卡斯特迪」——「卡」住人、看「守」住，就是拘留或监护；只是读音联想，与词源无关。

root: 拉丁语 custos（看守者、监护人，属格 custodis）派生出 custodia（看守、守护）→ 盎格鲁-法语 custodie → 英语 custody，核心义「处于看守之下」。

sensesIntro.en: Custody starts from the guarding of a child, extends to the safe keeping of things, then to police detention, imprisonment, and the official keeping of records.
sensesIntro.cn: custody 从对孩子的监护开始，延伸到对物品的妥善保管，再到警方拘留、监禁，以及对记录的官方保管。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: two hands forming a fence around someone in need of care.
core.cn: 核心意象：两只手围成护栏，护住需要照顾的人。

branches.en: The guardian who watches a child holds the first sense.
branches.cn: 看护孩子的监护人拥有第一个义项。

branches.en: The same guarding spreads from persons to valuable things.
branches.cn: 同样的看守从人扩展到贵重物品。

branches.en: When the state guards a person, the result is police detention.
branches.cn: 当国家看住一个人时，结果就是警方拘留。

branches.en: A guarded hold that continues after sentence becomes imprisonment.
branches.cn: 宣判后仍持续的看管就变成监禁。

branches.en: Keeping a painting and keeping a record are both forms of official custody.
branches.cn: 保管一幅画与保管一份记录，都是官方保管的形式。

intro.en: Custody grows from Latin custos and custodia, with English custodian, custodial, and custodianship around it.
intro.cn: custody 从拉丁语 custos 与 custodia 生长出来，周围有英语 custodian、custodial 与 custodianship。

latinIntro.en: Latin custos means a guardian or watchman, and custodia means guarding or watchful care.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 custos 意为看守者或监护人，custodia 意为看守、守护。

items.example: Custos is the person who keeps watch.
Custodis supplies the stem for custodia.
items.exampleCN: custodis 为 custodia 提供词干。

items.example: Custodia is the state of being guarded.
Custodire is the verb of keeping watch.
items.exampleCN: custodire 是表示看守的动词。

items.example: Custody keeps the Latin guarding sense.
items.exampleCN: custody 保留了拉丁语「看守」的含义。

items.example: Custodian names the person who guards.
Custodial describes the duty of care.
The ending -ia turns custos into custodia.
items.exampleCN: 词尾 -ia 把 custos 变成 custodia。
